| D-P31.1-1 | F | `/v1/contradiction` and `/v1/task` cost ~10 s per request: `PgReadStore._spine_watermark` counts every claim (2.3M) plus the evidence tables on every call, under the annotation lock, so concurrent calls queue (8 concurrent workers: median 48 s, max 84 s; all 200) | pre-existing since P25.10 (the 2026-09-16 image measured the same 10.6–10.8 s); a cheaper watermark (e.g. a monotone marker instead of full counts) or a short TTL is a caching/serve-path design change, and caching is out of P31.1's scope | an API serve-path ticket (BL-057) | a single `/v1/contradiction` under ~1 s warm and 8 concurrent calls without queueing, with the watermark still provably never stale | `/health` and every other route stay fast while annotation calls queue (the lock is taken before a pooled connection, P31.1) | OPEN 2026-09-24 (P31.1; cites BL-057) · **P31.19 sweep 2026-09-27 — stays OPEN:** unscheduled engineering (BL-057, no chain row); the fix is a serve-path/caching design change with its own ticket — nothing engineering-side is owed by the closeout.  **P32.1 baseline 2026-09-27 — scheduled home verified:** the defect is live in code at `api/src/api/store_pg.py` `_spine_watermark` (six relation counts per annotation call under the annotation lock); scheduled owner **P32.4** (bounded, correctly-invalidated watermark under the shared temporal contract; e2e evidence at P32.24). Row stays OPEN. **DONE 2026-10-11 (P32.4 / ADR-123):** `_spine_watermark` now reads the trigger-maintained `spine_watermark` table — an O(27 facets) probe, bounded by construction, replacing the per-request six-relation scan (`db/deploy/shared_temporal_contract.sql` + `db.occurrences.spine_watermark`). Statement-level SECURITY DEFINER triggers on INSERT / the permitted sys_period-close UPDATE / TRUNCATE bump each facet in the same transaction as its write — snapshot-consistent and provably never stale (over-invalidation only). Invalidation verified for all three required classes on real PG18: new claim (`claim` row_count+bump), correction (`sys_period` close → `closed_count`+1, row_count unchanged), completed materialization (`camera_site_execution` insert bumps its facet) — `tests/db/test_temporal_contract.py::test_watermark_tracks_claim_correction_and_completion` (20/20 pass). Bounded-plan evidence: `EXPLAIN` of the watermark read plans against `spine_watermark` only (same test file). Composed/hosted latency evidence (<1s warm, 8-way no-queue) remains reserved to the P32.24/P33.2 e2e verify row per the scheduled plan — this closure is the engineering defect fix plus deterministic local evidence, not a hosted measurement claim. **Measured local evidence 2026-10-11:** `docs/build/reports/p32.4-watermark/RESULTS.md` — `p31-scale-local` fixture at the defect's exact 2.3M-claim scale (Docker PG18, full production sqitch plan): bounded read warm p99 1.81 ms / 8-way concurrent p99 37.7 ms vs the legacy six-count scan's 8-way median 5,035 ms / max 12.2 s (~316×; 4 shared-hit blocks vs 20.5k/170.7k) — the named budget (warm p99 <10 ms, 8-way p99 <50 ms, no spine scan) holds; reproduce `docs/build/tools/measure_watermark_p31.py`. |
